installedProfile.invocation: The checked host directly invokes the native executable selected from the captured installed platform package. The version gate and existing compilation flags remain mandatory.
installedProfile.capture: Retain all regular package files, including package metadata, compiler code, native executable, declarations and licenses. Paths are package-relative and sorted by code units. No mtime enters identity.
installedProfile.stability: After successful compilation, re-enumerate both trees and re-hash every file. Added, missing or changed files reject before final publication.
installedProfile.filesystem: Package roots resolve before capture; linked descendants and non-regular files reject. Trusted local filesystem behavior remains assumed: before/after checks do not defeat malicious transient substitution.

customEntryProfile: Explicit non-package launchers retain their exact entry bytes and before/after checks, with entry-only coverage. They do not claim dependency discovery.
artifactBinding: The canonical manifest contains every package-relative path and byte ArtifactId. It is the TypeScript pass implementation identity and an action dependency. The observed build archive retains every referenced byte snapshot.
remaining: host runtime, OS libraries and ambient environment
filesystem/module/type resolution outside the selected package trees
generated compiler and selected provider execution closure
independent compiler preservation and source-binary correspondence
release distribution and authenticated toolchain pins
authority: Observed byte integrity and stable inventory do not establish semantic acceptance, reproducibility, preservation, complete toolchain closure or eligibility for semantic cache reuse.
